title.zh: 漢興以來諸侯王年表 - Table of the Years of Feudal Lords since the Rise of the Han Dynasty
title.raw: 《漢興以來諸侯王年表 - Table of the Years of Feudal Lords since the Rise of the Han Dynasty》

sentences.zh: 太史公曰：殷以前尚矣。

translations.literal: Grand Historian said: Yin before still ancient.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian said: Before the Yin period, matters are too ancient to judge.

sentences.zh: 周封五等：公，侯，伯，子，男。

translations.literal: Zhou enfeoffed five ranks: duke, marquis, earl, viscount, baron.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou enfeoffed five ranks: duke, marquis, earl, viscount, and baron.

sentences.zh: 然封伯禽、康叔於魯、衛，地各四百里，親親之義，褒有德也；

translations.literal: However enfeoffed Bo Qin, Kang Shu at Lu, Wei, territories each four hundred li, love relatives principle, praise have virtue also;
translations.idiomatic: Yet when Bo Qin and Kang Shu were enfeoffed in Lu and Wei, each received a territory of four hundred li, to honor kinship and reward virtue.

sentences.zh: 太公於齊，兼五侯地，尊勤勞也。

translations.literal: Tai Gong at Qi, combined five marquises territory, honor diligent labor also.
translations.idiomatic: Tai Gong at Qi combined the territories of five marquises, in recognition of his toil and service.

sentences.zh: 武王、成、康所封數百，而同姓五十五，地上不過百里，下三十里，以輔衛王室。

translations.literal: Wu Wang, Cheng, Kang enfeoffed several hundred, while same surname fifty-five, territory top not exceed hundred li, bottom thirty li, to assist protect royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Wu, Cheng, and Kang enfeoffed several hundred nobles, while those of the same surname numbered fifty-five. Their territories ranged from no more than a hundred li to as little as thirty li, to aid and protect the royal house.

sentences.zh: 管、蔡、康叔、曹、鄭，或過或損。

translations.literal: Guan, Cai, Kang Shu, Cao, Zheng, some exceed some reduce.
translations.idiomatic: Guan, Cai, Kang Shu, Cao, and Zheng - some went beyond the limits, some fell short.

sentences.zh: 厲、幽之後，王室缺，侯伯彊國興焉，天子微，弗能正。

translations.literal: Li, You after, royal house deficient, marquises earls strong states rise there, Son of Heaven weak, not able correct.
translations.idiomatic: After Li and You, the royal house declined; powerful states among the feudal lords rose up, and the Son of Heaven grew too weak to correct them.

sentences.zh: 非德不純，形勢弱也。

translations.literal: Not virtue not pure, strategic position weak also.
translations.idiomatic: It was not that virtue was impure, but that strategic position was weak.

sentences.zh: 漢興，序二等。

translations.literal: Han rose, ranked two grades.
translations.idiomatic: When Han rose, it established two ranks.

sentences.zh: 高祖末年，非劉氏而王者，若無功上所不置而侯者，天下共誅之。

translations.literal: Gao Zu end years, not Liu clan while king ones, if no merit emperor not establish while marquis ones, world together execute them.
translations.idiomatic: In Gao Zu's final years, those not of the Liu clan who became kings, and those without merit whom the emperor did not establish as marquises—the world together would execute them.

sentences.zh: 高祖子弟同姓為王者九國，雖獨長沙異姓，而功臣侯者百有餘人。

translations.literal: Gao Zu sons brothers same surname become kings nine states, although only Changsha different surname, while meritorious ministers marquis ones hundred plus persons.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Zu's sons and brothers of the same surname who became kings numbered nine states, although only Changsha was of a different surname, while meritorious ministers who became marquises numbered over a hundred.

sentences.zh: 自雁門、太原以東至遼陽，為燕代國；

translations.literal: From Yanmen, Taiyuan east to Liaoyang, became Yan Dai states;
translations.idiomatic: From Yanmen, Taiyuan east to Liaoyang, became Yan Dai states;

sentences.zh: 常山以南，大行左轉，度河、濟，阿、甄以東薄海，為齊、趙國；

translations.literal: Changshan south, Taihang left turn, cross Yellow River, Ji, A, Zhen east reach sea, became Qi, Zhao states;
translations.idiomatic: Changshan south, Taihang left turn, cross Yellow River, Ji, A, Zhen east reach sea, became Qi, Zhao states;

sentences.zh: 自陳以西，南至九疑，東帶江、淮、谷、泗，薄會稽，為梁、楚、淮南、長沙國：皆外接於胡、越。

translations.literal: From Chen west, south to Jiuyi, east border Jiang, Huai, Gu, Si, reach Kuaiji, became Liang, Chu, Huainan, Changsha states: all externally connect to Hu, Yue.
translations.idiomatic: From Chen west, south to Jiuyi, east border Jiang, Huai, Gu, Si, reach Kuaiji, became Liang, Chu, Huainan, Changsha states: all externally connect to Hu, Yue.

sentences.zh: 而內地北距山以東盡諸侯地，大者或五六郡，連城數十，置百官宮觀，僭於天子。

translations.literal: While inner lands north border mountains east exhaust feudal lords territories, large ones or five six commanderies, connected cities dozens, established hundred officials palaces temples, presumptuously toward Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The inner lands bordered mountains to the north and extended east to exhaust the feudal lords' territories. Large ones comprised five or six commanderies, with connected cities numbering dozens. They established hundreds of officials, palaces, and temples, presuming to rival the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 漢獨有三河、東郡、潁川、南陽，自江陵以西至蜀，北自雲中至隴西，與內史凡十五郡，而公主列侯頗食邑其中。

translations.literal: Han alone had Sanhe, Dongjun, Yingchuan, Nanyang, from Jiangling west to Shu, north from Yunzhong to Longxi, with inner minister altogether fifteen commanderies, while princesses marquises considerably eat fiefs therein.
translations.idiomatic: Han alone held Sanhe, Dongjun, Yingchuan, and Nanyang commanderies, from Jiangling west to Shu, north from Yunzhong to Longxi, together with the inner minister making fifteen commanderies total, while princesses and marquises considerably held fiefs within them.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 天下初定，骨肉同姓少，故廣彊庶孽，以鎮撫四海，用承衛天子也。

translations.literal: World initially pacified, close relatives same surname few, therefore extensively strengthened collateral branches, to pacify stabilize four seas, used to support protect Son of Heaven also.
translations.idiomatic: The world had just been pacified, close relatives of the same surname were few, so the collateral branches were extensively strengthened to pacify and stabilize the four seas, serving to support and protect the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 漢定百年之閒，親屬益疏，諸侯或驕奢，忕邪臣計謀為淫亂，大者叛逆，小者不軌于法，以危其命，殞身亡國。

translations.literal: Han pacified hundred years interval, relatives increasingly distant, feudal lords some arrogant extravagant, followed evil ministers schemed for lewd disorder, large ones rebelled, small ones not followed by law, to endanger their lives, perished bodies lost states.
translations.idiomatic: Within a century of Han's pacification, relatives grew increasingly distant, some feudal lords became arrogant and extravagant, following evil ministers who schemed for lewd disorder. The great ones rebelled, the small ones violated the law, endangering their lives, perishing their bodies and losing their states.

sentences.zh: 天子觀於上古，然後加惠，使諸侯得推恩分子弟國邑，故齊分為七，趙分為六，梁分為五，淮南分三，及天子支庶子為王，王子支庶為侯，百有餘焉。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven observed ancient times, then added favor, caused feudal lords able extend favor divide sons brothers state cities, therefore Qi divided into seven, Zhao into six, Liang into five, Huainan into three, and Son of Heaven collateral sons become kings, kings collateral sons become marquises, hundred plus thereupon.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven observed ancient precedents, then extended favor, allowing feudal lords to extend benevolence and divide territories among their sons and younger brothers. Therefore Qi was divided into seven, Zhao into six, Liang into five, Huainan into three, while the Son of Heaven's collateral sons became kings, and kings' collateral sons became marquises—over a hundred in total.

sentences.zh: 吳楚時，前后諸侯或以適削地，是以燕、代無北邊郡，吳、淮南、長沙無南邊郡，齊、趙、梁、楚支郡名山陂海咸納於漢。

translations.literal: Wu Chu time, earlier later feudal lords some by fault had lands cut, therefore Yan, Dai lacked north border commanderies, Wu, Huainan, Changsha lacked south border commanderies, Qi, Zhao, Liang, Chu detached commanderies famous mountains lakes marshes seas all absorbed into Han.
translations.idiomatic: During the revolt of Wu and Chu, kings were sooner or later stripped of territory for their offenses. Yan and Dai were left without northern frontier commanderies; Wu, Huainan, and Changsha without southern frontier commanderies; while detached jurisdictions of Qi, Zhao, Liang, and Chu—together with storied heights, lakes, marshes, and coastal tracts—were all absorbed into the Han domain.

sentences.zh: 諸侯稍微，大國不過十餘城，小侯不過數十里，上足以奉貢職，下足以供養祭祀，以蕃輔京師。

translations.literal: Feudal lords slightly weakened, large states not exceed ten plus cities, small marquises not exceed several ten li, above sufficient pay tribute duties, below sufficient supply support sacrifices, to multiply assist capital.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords were slightly weakened. Large states did not exceed ten or more cities, small marquises did not exceed several dozen li. Above they were sufficient to pay tribute and duties, below sufficient to supply support for sacrifices, multiplying assistance to the capital.

sentences.zh: 而漢郡八九十，形錯諸侯閒，犬牙相臨，秉其阸塞地利，彊本干，弱枝葉之勢，尊卑明而萬事各得其所矣。

translations.literal: While Han commanderies eighty ninety, interlocked feudal lords between, interlocking teeth mutually adjacent, grasped their strategic passes terrain advantages, strengthened trunk root, weakened branches leaves posture, honor low clear and myriad matters each obtained their place.
translations.idiomatic: While Han commanderies numbered eighty or ninety, interspersed among the feudal lords like dog teeth interlocking, controlling strategic choke points and terrain advantages, strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches—a clear hierarchy where everything found its proper place.

sentences.zh: 臣遷謹記高祖以來至太初諸侯，譜其下益損之時，令時世得覽。

translations.literal: Minister Qian respectfully records Gao Zu since to Tai Chu feudal lords, tabulated their below increase decrease times, caused age world able view.
translations.idiomatic: I, Minister Qian, respectfully record the feudal lords from Gaozu to the Taichu era, charting the times when their holdings waxed and waned, so that later ages may examine them.

sentences.zh: 形勢雖彊，要之以仁義為本。

translations.literal: Strategic position although strong, essential with benevolence righteousness as foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Though strategic power may be strong, in the end the essential thing is to make benevolence and righteousness the foundation.

cells.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day Bingyin, the first year of King Youyuan began. You was a son of Gaozu.

cells.idiomatic: In the first year of the king’s reign, on the bingzi day of the first month.

cells.idiomatic: It further pertains to the state of Wu. On the xin-chou day of the tenth month, it was the first year of King Bi. Bi was the elder son of Gaozu's brother Zhongzi, formerly the Marquis of Pei. (idiomatic).

cells.idiomatic: Nineteen. Moved to Qinghe. Became Taiyuan Commandery. (idiomatic).

cells.content: 思王商元年。商，常山憲王子。
cells.literal: The first year of Si Wang Shang. Shang was the son of Xian, King of Changshan.
cells.idiomatic: In the first year of King Si of Shang. Shang was the son of King Xian of Changshan.

cells.literal: King Qing's first year of reign
cells.idiomatic: The first year of King Qing's reign

cells.content: 二十。代王義徙清河年。是為剛王。
cells.literal: Twenty. The King Yi of Dai moved to Qinghe this year. He is called King Gang.
cells.idiomatic: Twenty. The King Yi of Dai moved to Qinghe this year. He is called King Gang. (idiomatic).

cells.content: 更為真定國。頃王平元年。常山憲王子。
cells.literal: Further established as Zhen State. In the first year of King Ping of Qing, he was the son of Prince Xian of Changshan.
cells.idiomatic: Further established as Zhen State. In the first year of King Ping of Qing, he was the son of Prince Xian of Changshan. (idiomatic).

cells.literal: In the first year of King Ai Chang. In the same year he died.
cells.idiomatic: In the first year of King Ai's reign, Changyuan. He passed away in the same year.
The first year of King Kang of Kunshi.

cells.literal: Eight. Passed away, no descendants, the state was abolished and turned into a commandery.
cells.idiomatic: Died without an heir, the state was abolished and turned into a commandery.

cells.literal: In the first year of King Qing's reign, Yuan was left behind.
cells.idiomatic: The first year of King Qing's reign.

cells.literal: King Hui of Wu, first year
cells.idiomatic: The first year of King Hui's reign, Wuyuan

cells.literal: 47. Died, left no heir, the state was abolished.
cells.idiomatic: 47. Passed away without an heir, the state was abolished.

cells.literal: Twenty-three. Paid homage to Mount Tai.
Year One of King Dai Tongping
First Year of the Tai Chu Era
cells.idiomatic: The first year of Tai Chu

cells.content: 哀王安世元年。即戴王賀元年。安世子。
cells.literal: In the first year of King Ai An Shiyuan. Then in the first year of King Ji Dai He. Son of An Shi.
cells.idiomatic: In the first year of King Ai An Shiyuan. Then in the first year of King Dai He. An Shi Zi.
